name: Olivia London Leyva
bio:
Olivia London Leyva is a bilingual American child actress, dancer, and voice artist. She began her professional acting career in commercial work and short films before transitioning to television and major studio feature productions.

She made her film debut starring as Mariela in the independent short film Yes (2024), followed by a guest-starring role as Sofia in the NBC comedy series Lopez vs. Lopez (2025). Leyva is set to make her major feature film debut voicing the prominent role of Nina in CoComelon: The Movie (2027) for Universal Pictures and DreamWorks Animation.

In addition to her acting work, she has extensive training in dance, including jazz and hip-hop, and is represented theatrically and for voiceover by The Osbrink Agency.
